test_title: PYST 06: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : AIP :: MRV : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : AIP :: MRV : %

Option 1) # = ELR, % = QUX → ELR : AIP :: MRV : QUX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/249b448fb0a5ec7dc08c89c4d62fbb74679cb73131fcc7032aaeb231187de027.png] 

Option 2) # = WFN, % = QUX → WFN : AIP :: MRV : QUX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e80db59710f3fa8d7b5cabbac1f85b6819cf8b01e7a56e0b7780d3731a57c97.png] 

Option 3) # = IOT, % = WFN → IOT : AIP :: MRV : WFN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92125d5c6049e67c8b1839fa3bce091da661dd0206e80a844769e3f30db11fc8.png] 

Option 4) # = QUX, % = ELR → QUX : AIP :: MRV : ELR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97c6ce5c5d8060643b505be43c2cee8d0a8596ec49cdc9c25573b36b3c5c140f.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
